cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'm sorry I broke your graduation mug. Losing it is exactly how we learn to let go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. That urge is why we needed this. We've confused a degree with a drinking vessel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give me your graduation mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Losing mine will teach me generosity. We should both drink from jam jars tomorrow.

mechanism: A teaches disappointment as a precisely needed lesson and corrects practical objections into further growth.
confusable: Cheerful reframing differs from claiming this exact loss was necessary for development.
comparison: A bakery contract threatens equipment payments; a broken personal mug forces A to share the advocated loss.
seedUse: Use the contract and graduation keepsake seeds, but avoid borrowing unrelated bakery reference entitlement.
